Claim 2: L2a compares the warm-started learner with the label-free agreement threshold. Both use the same audit budget (154 audits at 10%, 386 at 25%), and the threshold reads no labels, so it has no information advantage. At 10%, the 95% CIs of the ratio are [0.837, 1.134] at T=0.25 and [0.980, 1.210] at T=0.5. Both span 1.0. The 25% CIs also include 1.0. So claim 2 is not_supported, and the free-label confound was controlled, so W2 is false. Claim 3: no non-E01 entry is on a different model, task or proxy. E21, L1a and L3a all use the same Qwen 1.5B, GSM8K and majority-vote setup. Their embedding AUC gains are 0.001 to 0.010, and no gain or neighbor ratio reaches the support thresholds. So the kill is not licensed and claim 3 is open. The ledger does not assert claim 3 is supported, so W3 is false.
